title: Samsung is working on a central hub to track all your blocked calls
summary: This could likely be a One UI 9.5 special.
body: TL;DR Samsung is working on a dedicated Blocked calls dashboard for its Phone app in One UI 9.5. The dashboard shows calls blocked over the past 30 days, categorized into potential fraud, suspected spam, and manually blocked calls. The feature was manually enabled and is still in development, with no confirmed release date. Your Samsung Galaxy can already block unwanted calls , and the South Korean tech giant now appears to be preparing an easy way for you to keep track of just how many such calls your phone has filtered out. For what it’s worth, blocked-call history isn’t entirely new. You can already head to the Phone app > Recents > the three-dot menu and toggle on/off the option to view/hide blocked calls. However, what Samsung seems to be working on is a more detailed dashboard.

One of the big features being promoted is the ability to act as a translation tool, helping to break down language barriers, but some aspects of that support end up working a lot better than others. What works, and actually works well A few days ago, I had the opportunity to get some early hands-on time with the smart glasses at Gentle Monster’s New York pop-up. title: Google brings Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Search with smarter answers and better visuals
summary: Google Search is learning to read between the lines, and typos.
body: TL;DR Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Search users worldwide, promising smarter, more relevant answers. Search can now better understand complicated questions, multiple requests, and typos while finding information from a wider range of websites. You can expect more visual responses, including images, comparison tables, and interactive tools across all AI Mode-supported languages. Google Search is getting a major upgrade, and it could noticeably change how you find information online. Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen to all users worldwide, bringing smarter answers, better visuals, and a better understanding of even the most complicated questions. One of the biggest changes is that you won’t have to be quite as careful about how you phrase your searches. Whether you’re asking several questions at once, making a few typos, or looking for something very specific, Google says Search will be better at figuring out what you actually need.

title: New OnePlus update gives phones and tablets the ability to auto-unlock PCs
summary: Your OnePlus device now acts as a key to unlock your computer.
body: Credit: Stephen Radochia / Android Authority TL;DR OnePlus is rolling out a new OxygenOS 16 update for phones and tablets. The update introduces the ability to automatically unlock your PC with your mobile device. The rollout is expected to reach all users around November 19, 2026. It would be nice if phones and PCs had more cross-device functionality than they currently have. Microsoft has been working toward that goal, releasing features like a Mobile devices tile that lets users toggle Do Not Disturb mode, adjust the phone’s volume, or make it play a sound when misplaced. But Microsoft isn’t the only company trying to bring PCs and phones closer together. OnePlus is rolling out a new feature that would be very convenient for PC users. This week, OnePlus announced the rollout of its November update. Phones will be getting version C20P01(BRB1EX01), while tablets will receive version C20P01(BRB3EX01). For OxygenOS 16 devices, this update will introduce the ability to automatically unlock your PC with your mobile device.

title: بمساعدة مبابي.. ريال مدريد يرفض الاستسلام في صفقة أوليسي
summary: يقدم النجم الفرنسي مايكل أوليسي، موسمًا مميزًا مع ناديه بايرن ميونخ، لكن مستقبله على المدى الطويل، قد يكون بعيداً عن العملاق البافاري.
body: يقدم النجم الفرنسي مايكل أوليسي، موسمًا مميزًا مع ناديه بايرن ميونخ، لكن مستقبله على المدى الطويل، قد يكون بعيداً عن العملاق البافاري. وذكرت شبكة GFFN الفرنسية، نقلًا عن صحيفة " ليكيب " أن اهتمام ريال مدريد بالتعاقد مع أوليسي، لم يتراجع. وكان بايرن ميونخ، قد أبلغ ريال مدريد في الصيف الماضي، بأن تقديم عرض تتجاوز قيمته 500 مليون يورو، لن يكون كافيًا للسماح برحيل أوليسي. وينتهي عقد صانع الألعاب الفرنسي مع بايرن ميونخ في عام 2029، ومن المتوقع أن يكثف النادي الألماني، جهوده خلال الأيام المقبلة من أجل تمديده. ومع ذلك، لا يزال مايكل أوليسي، هدفاً لريال مدريد. فعندما ينضم إلى معسكر المنتخب الفرنسي، يحرص لاعبون من أمثال كيليان مبابي وإبراهيما كوناتي وإدواردو كامافينجا، على تذكيره، بأن ملعب سانتياجو برنابيو مكان رائع لممارسة كرة القدم. وتشير صحيفة ليكيب، إلى أنه في حال فشل بايرن ميونخ في مساعيه لتمديد عقد اللاعب الفرنسي، فقد يصبح متاحاً في سوق الانتقالات الصيفية المقبلة، مقابل مبلغ أقل بكثير من 500 مليون يورو. وظهر مايكل أوليسي، بشكل رائع خلال مونديال 2026 مع منتخب فرنسا، وساهم في احتلال الديوك، المركز الرابع. وشارك أوليسي في 15 مباراة هذا الموسم مع بايرن ميونخ بكافة المسابقات، وسجل 12 هدفا، مع تقديم 7 تمريرات حاسمة. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة

title: Exclusive: Google’s hidden list of 134 apps that support Gemini task automation

body: Credit: Megan Ellis / Android Authority TL;DR Google’s hidden server-side target app list on Android 17 reveals 134 apps tied to Gemini task automation: 114 on stable Android 17 QPR2 and 20 extra test entries on Android Canary 2611. Apps must appear on this allowlist with matching Play Store signing certificates to run automated tasks, meaning regional Indian apps like Zomato and Blinkit work while unlisted rivals like Swiggy and Zepto are currently blocked. Being on the list does not guarantee immediate functionality, as productivity apps like Microsoft Word and Outlook are listed but don’t yet support direct in-app automation through Gemini. Gemini’s task automation is one of the more ambitious and impressive things Google has shipped on Android this year. Instead of handing you a link, Gemini opens the app on a virtual screen, taps through it on your behalf, and stops just before checkout so you can confirm. It began rolling out in March with just six apps: Lyft, Uber, Grubhub, DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Starbucks, on the Galaxy S26 series and later the Pixel 10 series . title: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid mounting scandals
summary: CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO.
body: TL;DR Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of NVIDIA. The move follows two scandals: an affair with a foreign intelligence agent and one with a direct NVIDIA report. CFO Colette Kress has been appointed interim CEO as the board searches for a replacement. In a move that has seemed inevitable for the past few days, Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of NVIDIA, according to a statement from the company . The decision was announced by NVIDIA’s board of directors who appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. Kress will serve in both roles until NVIDIA appoints a permanent replacement CEO. The board said it is considering both internal and external candidates.

We’ve seen mixed results in our own testing, although Tears of the Kingdom saw huge gains. Snapdragon-powered devices are often considered the best for emulation , and that’s largely due to the rise of open-source Turnip drivers. These unofficial GPU drivers can deliver significantly better performance and compatibility in many emulators. Samsung phones and tablets with Exynos chips have mostly been left in the lurch as a result, resulting in inferior emulation. However, a new custom driver has delivered a major boost. Developer JimVulkan released radv-xclipse on GitHub last month for Samsung phones with Exynos chips. This is a port of the open-source RADV Vulkan driver for AMD GPUs. Of course, it’s worth noting that recent Exynos processors have Xclipse GPUs based on AMD graphics technology.

body: TL;DR Google Wallet is gaining digital home keys, allowing Android users to unlock compatible smart locks with an NFC tap or hands-free using UWB. The feature supports select Aliro-compatible locks from Aqara, Schlage, and Nuki, with one digital key working across multiple locks in the same home. The functionality is rolling out to Google Home Public Preview users starting today, November 11, with wider availability expected over the coming weeks. Smart locks have already made getting into homes a lot more convenient than it traditionally used to be, and Google is now making that process even more seamless by bringing digital home keys directly into Google Wallet . Starting today, those in the Google Home app’s Public Preview will have the option to add their digital home keys to Google Wallet, allowing compatible smart lock owners to unlock doors by simply walking up to it or tapping their phones against the lock.

Not every device needs replacing just because it missed the smart home revolution. That old stereo gathering dust might still sound better than your shiny new wireless speaker , while your TV or heating system could be perfectly capable of following commands without an internet connection. Home Assistant wants to bridge that gap with a new accessory that gives yesterday’s technology a place in today’s connected home. The new Home Assistant Connect AUX-2 is a multi-purpose accessory from Nabu Casa, the company behind official Home Assistant hardware. Rather than adding yet another gadget to your home, Connect AUX-2 is designed to make better use of the ones you already own, bringing older audio systems, TVs, solar equipment, and more into an existing Home Assistant setup.

Furthermore, the group said that GrapheneOS based on Android 17 QPR2 indeed supports MTE functionality. title: The best Nova Launcher alternative isn’t on the Play Store — here’s how to install it
summary: You don't need Nova Launcher to enjoy a Nova Launcher-like home screen.
body: Although I no longer use it, there’s little doubt in my mind that Nova Launcher is a titan of the Android customization space. This app has seen the meteoric rise of the platform, from Ice Cream Sandwich right through to Android 17, and in that time, the launcher has experienced plenty of ups and downs itself. It was effectively abandonware at one point, then sold, then sold again, and now leaves once-committed users like me questioning its development trajectory . After its initial sale, Nova Launcher’s co-founder stated that an open-source release of the home screen was in the works, and suggested that should he leave the development team, that version would be made broadly available for fans to continue its legacy. More than a year since that post and the launcher’s sale to its current owner, there’s no indication that it’ll ever be open-sourced — at least not in an official capacity.
